dayloCsrf.description: Session-bound CSRF proof. Angular reads the daylo_xsrf cookie and attaches this header automatically; direct clients can use GET /api/auth/csrf. The exact configured frontend Origin is also required.
dayloCsrf.name: X-CSRF-Token

info.description: Daylo public API. HTTPS authenticated operations use the HttpOnly __Host-daylo_session cookie (daylo_session on local development HTTP). Unsafe requests require the session-bound X-CSRF-Token and exact configured frontend Origin. Only GET /api/auth/session renews valid sessions for seven days, capped at 30 days from creation; expired/revoked sessions cannot be renewed.
info.title: Daylo API

get.description: Returns a stable token for this session. Keep it in memory and send X-CSRF-Token on unsafe requests. Does not renew the session; available to pending users.

401.description: Authentication required: session missing, expired or revoked.

429.description: Per-IP API budget exceeded. HTML Google navigation redirects to /login?error=rate-limit instead. Rejections do not revoke sessions.

get.description: Navigate the browser to this endpoint; do not call through the generated HTTP client. Creates a ten-minute browser-bound single-use OIDC transaction. No Daylo session is created.

302.description: Redirect to Google. Sets the HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax __Host-daylo_oauth_browser cookie on HTTPS (daylo_oauth_browser on local development HTTP). HTML navigation failures redirect to fixed frontend error destinations.

get.description: Google browser callback, protected by state, nonce and browser binding, not the ordinary mutation CSRF header. Verified identities pass application admission; outsiders are denied with 403. Admitted users receive a Daylo session and a fixed frontend redirect. Identity and provider tokens are never returned.

parameters.description: Google authorization code; required for a successful provider response.
parameters.name: code

parameters.description: Google refusal/error identifier; cannot be combined with a successful response.
parameters.name: error

302.description: Sets __Host-daylo_session on HTTPS (daylo_session on local development HTTP); active users redirect to /today, pending users to /invitations. HTML navigation failures redirect to the fixed frontend /login with an allowlisted error reason (denied, failed or connection).

401.description: GOOGLE_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: invalid, expired or reused transaction, denied consent, or invalid identity token.

403.description: ACCESS_FORBIDDEN: no application admission or identity email collision.

get.description: Returns active or pending identity and renews a still-valid session and its cookie for seven days, capped at 30 days from session creation. Missing, expired or revoked sessions return 401 and cannot be renewed. Call on application entry and foreground return; do not poll to keep sessions alive.
